$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/policy.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

owners.description: RFC 6901 prefix into the patchable view → teams that review an experiment arm touching it, at or under the prefix, or replacing what contains it, e.g. { "/nodes/safety_filter": ["trust-safety"] }. stratarec explain-plan lists each arm's owners for code review to route.
